open_points: The chase picker that chooses the landmark on the route ahead is the one-shot's (the route is map.json's driving graph); these are the words only.
Ron's three-beat lines are written once per landmark here; his own-line voice for the rest is TO WRITE in own-ron_kirby.json.
note: Landmark direction lines: whoever rides with Frank says the way by landmark (no marker). kind:passenger is whoever rides with Frank: Ron, a crewman, or a fare who knows the town (people whose card says so). turn and side let the picker match a line to the road ahead on map.json's driving graph (mode foot lines only in foot chases). counts_for_gv03 false marks Ron's three-beat running joke, a voice line. At least one counting line a 20 s of chase (GV-03).
